entities.name: EPS attach type
entities.description: Information element that indicates the type of the requested attach in EPS. It is a type 1 information element with specific coding rules.

entities.name: EPS attach type IEI
entities.description: Information Element Identifier for EPS attach type, located in bits 8-5 of octet 1.

entities.name: Spare bit 4
entities.description: Bit 4 of octet 1 is spare and shall be coded as zero in the EPS attach type IE.

entities.name: EPS attach type value
entities.description: 3-bit field in bits 3-1 of octet 1 encoding the attach type: 001=EPS attach, 010=combined EPS/IMSI attach, 011=EPS RLOS attach, 110=EPS emergency attach, 111=reserved. All other values are unused and interpreted as 'EPS attach' by the network.

entities.name: Unused values condition
entities.description: All values of EPS attach type value other than the defined ones are unused and shall be interpreted as 'EPS attach' if received by the network.

entities.name: RLOS attach interpretation condition
entities.description: EPS RLOS attach shall be interpreted as 'EPS attach' by a network not supporting attach for access to RLOS.

relations.description: The EPS attach type IE contains the IEI field identifying it.
The EPS attach type IE contains a spare bit that must be coded as zero.
The EPS attach type IE contains the attach type value field encoding the specific attach type.
The attach type value field is guarded by the condition that unused values are interpreted as 'EPS attach'.
The attach type value field is guarded by the condition that EPS RLOS attach is interpreted as 'EPS attach' in networks not supporting RLOS.
